q1_issues.issue: The coordinated object of the relative clause ("lists moth-counts and weather notes") is collapsed into one `list` event carrying two `Theme` atoms, whereas Coordination & plurals makes coordinated NPs distributive by default (replicate the predication once per conjunct), the one-event/multiple-role form being reserved for reciprocal/aggregate predicates.

q2_gaps: a capitalized plural kind-word label under a quantifier ("A few Keepers") — the capitalized-common-noun default is declared "singular-collective only", and the plural rule is stated only for a label "referring as a name", so a counted/indefinite capitalized plural is addressed by neither branch
notes: Group + CardinalityPhrase "a few" + group event + per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) with the "each" QuantifierPhrase companion matches the counted-plural-with-distributive-predicate doctrine, and both compound genera (moth_count, weather_note) correctly withhold the noun-modifier genus.
